articles.title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review
articles.summary: England players are understood to have aired strong views about their World Cup semi-final defeat by Argentina in a team meeting.

articles.title: Burn replaces injured Guehi in England squad
articles.summary: Newcastle's Dan Burn is added to the England squad to play Croatia and Spain in the Nations League this week after Marc Guehi pulls out with a hip injury.

articles.title: Grand Slam of Darts 2026: Littler alongside Greaves in mouth-watering Group A
articles.summary: The draw for the Grand Slam of Darts 2026 has taken place with Luke Littler grouped alongside Beau Greaves and Niels Zonneveld to make a mouth-watering Group A.
